boards.title: Zero Dollars: 10 Hangs That Cost Nothing
boards.description: Ten public-library stops near NYU for reading, working, or meeting without an admission charge.

cards.title: Meet beneath the old courthouse tower
cards.subtitle: 425 Avenue of the Americas, Greenwich Village
cards.notes: Bring a book or a friend, find a seat in the former courthouse, and use the branch during its posted public hours.
cards.short_summary: A landmark Greenwich Village library in a former courthouse.
cards.evidence_claim: NYPL identifies Jefferson Market Library at 425 Avenue of the Americas and describes its Adult Reading Room in the former civil court; NYPL provides free and open access to its resources.
cards.source_title: Jefferson Market Library | The New York Public Library
cards.access_notes: Visit during posted branch hours; NYPL lists free resources and describes its mission as free and open access to information.

cards.title: Settle into the cast-iron district branch
cards.subtitle: 10 Jersey Street, SoHo
cards.notes: Use the ground-level entrance, choose a reading or work room, and make a low-key plan before heading back toward campus.
cards.short_summary: A SoHo branch built into a former chocolate-factory site.
cards.evidence_claim: NYPL identifies Mulberry Street Library at 10 Jersey Street, with reading and working rooms, computers, and free resources, classes, and events.
cards.source_title: Mulberry Street Library | The New York Public Library
cards.access_notes: Visit during posted branch hours; NYPL’s location page explicitly lists free resources, classes, and events.

cards.title: Read in a landmark East Village branch
cards.subtitle: 135 Second Avenue, East Village
cards.notes: Stop by the reading area, browse together, or use the computer lab; check the branch page for the day’s open hours.
cards.short_summary: NYC’s first free public-library branch, with a restored historic facade.
cards.evidence_claim: NYPL identifies Ottendorfer Library at 135 Second Avenue, calls it New York City’s first free public library, and lists free resources, classes, and events.
cards.source_title: Ottendorfer Library | The New York Public Library
cards.access_notes: Visit during posted branch hours; NYPL’s page lists free resources, classes, and events.

cards.title: Make a reading stop by Tompkins Square
cards.subtitle: 331 East 10th Street, East Village
cards.notes: Pair a library visit with a walk by the park, then choose a book, a table, or a branch program listed for the day.
cards.short_summary: A Carnegie-funded branch facing Tompkins Square Park.
cards.evidence_claim: NYPL identifies Tompkins Square Library at 331 East 10th Street, facing Tompkins Square Park, and lists free resources, classes, and events.
cards.source_title: Tompkins Square Library | The New York Public Library
cards.access_notes: Visit during posted branch hours; NYPL’s page lists free resources, classes, and events.

cards.title: Use the accessible Kips Bay branch
cards.subtitle: 446 Third Avenue, Kips Bay
cards.notes: Bring a study task or a shared reading list and use the branch’s public spaces during the hours NYPL posts online.
cards.short_summary: A fully accessible NYPL branch designed by Giorgio Cavaglieri.
cards.evidence_claim: NYPL identifies Kips Bay Library at 446 Third Avenue as fully accessible and describes it as a branch designed by Giorgio Cavaglieri; NYPL offers free and open access to resources.
cards.source_title: Kips Bay Library Reader’s Portal | The New York Public Library
cards.access_notes: Visit during posted branch hours; NYPL describes its mission as making information and knowledge freely available to all.

cards.title: Pause at the Chelsea branch
cards.subtitle: 209 West 23rd Street, Chelsea
cards.notes: Check the day’s hours, bring your own reading or coursework, and use this branch as a no-purchase indoor meet point.
cards.short_summary: A named NYPL location on West 23rd Street.
cards.evidence_claim: NYPL’s official location finder identifies Muhlenberg Library at 209 West 23rd Street; NYPL is dedicated to free and open access to information and knowledge.
cards.source_title: Find Your Library | The New York Public Library
cards.access_notes: Visit during posted branch hours; no admission or purchase is required to use NYPL’s free public resources.

cards.title: Gather at the Civic Center branch
cards.subtitle: 9 Murray Street, Civic Center
cards.notes: Use a table for a conversation or quiet reading, then confirm the current schedule on NYPL’s location finder before leaving.
cards.short_summary: A public-library stop near City Hall and the Brooklyn Bridge approach.
cards.evidence_claim: NYPL’s official location finder identifies New Amsterdam Library at 9 Murray Street; NYPL is dedicated to free and open access to information and knowledge.
cards.source_title: Find Your Library | The New York Public Library
cards.access_notes: Visit during posted branch hours; no admission or purchase is required to use NYPL’s free public resources.

cards.title: Choose a public-library reset on East 23rd
cards.subtitle: 228 East 23rd Street, Kips Bay
cards.notes: Meet inside for reading or a quiet check-in, and verify the branch’s current opening hours before you make the trip.
cards.short_summary: A named NYPL branch on East 23rd Street.
cards.evidence_claim: NYPL’s official location finder identifies Epiphany Library at 228 East 23rd Street; NYPL is dedicated to free and open access to information and knowledge.
cards.source_title: Find Your Library | The New York Public Library
cards.access_notes: Visit during posted branch hours; no admission or purchase is required to use NYPL’s free public resources.

cards.title: Browse near Chatham Square
cards.subtitle: 33 East Broadway, Chinatown
cards.notes: Bring a reading list or use the visit as a group pause; consult NYPL’s branch listing for the current hours and accessibility details.
cards.short_summary: A named NYPL branch in Chinatown near Chatham Square.
cards.evidence_claim: NYPL’s official location finder identifies Chatham Square Library at 33 East Broadway; NYPL is dedicated to free and open access to information and knowledge.
cards.source_title: Find Your Library | The New York Public Library
cards.access_notes: Visit during posted branch hours; no admission or purchase is required to use NYPL’s free public resources.

cards.title: Plan a Midtown library meet-up
cards.subtitle: 455 Fifth Avenue, Midtown
cards.notes: Use the library as a public reading or study stop; check its live branch page for hours and any room-specific rules.
cards.short_summary: NYPL’s circulating-library destination beside the Schwarzman Building.
cards.evidence_claim: NYPL’s official location finder identifies Stavros Niarchos Foundation Library at 455 Fifth Avenue and lists its public hours; NYPL provides free and open access to resources.
cards.source_title: Find Your Library | The New York Public Library
cards.access_notes: Visit during posted branch hours; no admission or purchase is required to use NYPL’s free public resources.
